control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action - material unwanted event control at TK-7101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on TK-7101, PSV-7101 and TK-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. TK-7101 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 12 May 2025 a corrective action on TK-7101, PSV-7101 and TK-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
